plate_findings.evidence: The scrotum dextra preparation is lined with stratified squamous epithelium with keratinized skin

panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 4 panels (A, B, C, D). A: Panel A shows the skin and lining characteristics of the cyst preparation, consistent with a testicular epidermoid cyst pathology. B: Panel B displays the internal structure of the cyst wall, confirming the lining characteristic of the targeted disease. C: Panel C shows the diagnostic hallmark of the cyst's contents: a mass of keratin within the lumen. D: Panel D shows the supporting stroma/connective tissue reaction in the context of the cystic lesion.

panels.figure_caption: The scrotum dextra preparation is lined with stratified squamous epithelium with keratinized skin with the dermis consisting of fibrocollagenous connective tissue, including skin adnexa within normal limits (a). Visible cyst structure with cyst wall lined with stratified squamous epithelium with cell nuclei within normal limits. Inside the lumen contains a mass of keratin (b, c, d).
